recognize_zh: 此視野只見紅血球背景中一個疊在紅血球上、帶深紫色點狀構造的小體，以及一顆深藍小圓體；沒有看到充滿無鞭毛體（amastigotes）的巨噬細胞，也難以確認核與動基體（kinetoplast），僅能部分支持利什曼原蟲。
features: Field dominated by red cells with rouleaux-like overlapping at the edges
One small oval body overlying a red cell with a dense purple dot, possibly a single extracellular amastigote but nucleus and kinetoplast not clearly resolved
A separate small, uniformly dark blue round body (possibly a small nucleus fragment or platelet)
No macrophages or clusters of intracellular organisms in this field
Few scattered tiny purple dots in the background
describe_en: Smear field composed mainly of red cells with scattered small debris. A single small oval body overlying a red cell contains a dense purple chromatin dot and could represent a free amastigote, but a distinct nucleus plus rod-shaped kinetoplast cannot be resolved at this magnification. No macrophages containing organisms are seen in this particular field. Therefore the image only partially supports the stated diagnosis of leishmaniasis; examination of histiocyte-rich areas for clusters of amastigotes with a nucleus and kinetoplast, or PCR/culture, is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Platelets are granular without an organized nucleus and bar-like kinetoplast, which define an amastigote.
Histoplasma yeasts are intracellular with a clear halo and a crescent nucleus but no kinetoplast.
These parasites are inside red cells as ring forms with blue cytoplasm, rather than free oval bodies with a kinetoplast.
